items.name: b12336
items.body:
<details open>

mtmd: require an F32 position embedding for HunyuanVL (#32131)

HunyuanVL resamples its position embedding on the host into a float
buffer sized for F32, then reads ggml_nbytes() of the tensor into it.
The graph never uses the tensor, so any type loads, and an F64 tensor
overflows the buffer at the first image request.

Require the position embedding to be present and F32 when loading the
HunyuanVL tensors.

</details>

items.name: b12328
items.body:
<details open>

ggml-backend : prefetch only inputs computed by earlier splits (#32100)

* ggml-backend : prefetch only inputs computed by earlier splits

The copy callback of a split runs after the prefetch and can write tensors that a later split reads, e.g. the MoE cache uploads missed experts into its bank. A prefetch of such a tensor reads it before the write.

* llama : skip the MoE cache when its device cannot run the cached mul_mat_id

Otherwise the scheduler runs the matmul on another backend and copies the whole bank every ubatch.

</details>
